n0e08835070.headline: Albanese says Australia vulnerable before fuel crisis as he announces $1bn in new loans for struggling businesses
n0e08835070.summary: Prime Minister Anthony Albanese said Australia must be better prepared for future shocks as he announced $1bn in new loans for struggling businesses. The announcement comes as fuel supply concerns are raised.
n0e08835070.why: Government-backed business lending affects credit conditions for small and mid-sized firms and can support activity during an economic shock.

ne7cda093ea.headline: CCS Meeting Today To Review Economic, Security Impact Of West Asia Conflict
ne7cda093ea.summary: India's Cabinet Committee on Security will meet to assess the escalating West Asia conflict's impact on food, fuel, fertiliser and trade. Officials said measures are being planned to ensure supply stability.
ne7cda093ea.why: The Cabinet Committee on Security is India's top body for national security decisions, and its economic measures can affect import-dependent sectors.

nfd3c7394ca.headline: Long, bumpy road ahead for fuel crisis, PM warns nation
nfd3c7394ca.summary: Prime Minister Anthony Albanese has warned Australians in a national address that the fuel crisis could worsen. He urged the public to take the situation seriously.
nfd3c7394ca.why: Fuel supply is critical to Australia's transport, agriculture and mining sectors. Prolonged shortages raise costs and can slow economic activity.

n1fd9f4cb11.headline: PSU banks emerge most resilient in FY26 despite macro headwinds, deliver up to 57% returns
n1fd9f4cb11.summary: State-run Indian banks delivered returns of up to 57% in FY26, outperforming as the Nifty 50 fell 5%. Better asset quality, strong balance sheets and credit growth supported the banks despite tariffs and FII outflows.
n1fd9f4cb11.why: Public sector banks are state-owned lenders that make up a large part of India's banking system. Their performance reflects credit demand, asset quality and government ownership.

impacts.name: Nifty 50
impacts.why: The benchmark fell 5% in FY26, the backdrop against which the state banks outperformed.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h

neeb7053b07.headline: Nike stock tumbles more than 13%, hits 11-year low as weakness in China, high oil prices weigh on outlook
neeb7053b07.summary: Nike stock fell more than 13% to an 11-year low as weakness in China and high oil prices weighed on its outlook. Investors are still waiting to see whether the turnaround continues.
neeb7053b07.why: Nike is a global athletic apparel company whose sales depend heavily on China and on consumer demand and input costs.
neeb7053b07.why_moved: The company's outlook was weighed down by weakness in China and high oil prices, according to the report.

n480fd7c183.headline: Starmer dismisses ‘noise’ after Trump says he is considering pulling out of Nato
n480fd7c183.summary: Prime Minister Keir Starmer dismissed comments as noise after Trump said he was considering pulling out of NATO. Starmer said he would not change Britain's involvement in the war against Iran.
n480fd7c183.why: NATO defence commitments and UK foreign policy affect defence spending, sterling sentiment and transatlantic trade relations.

n09839d4504.headline: Global Markets | Greek stocks set for MSCI developed market return by 2027, marking post-crisis milestone
n09839d4504.summary: Greece is set to rejoin developed market benchmarks in May 2027, ending its emerging market status after the 2009 debt crisis. Some analysts expect capital outflows and reduced visibility for Greek firms.
n09839d4504.why: MSCI is a global index provider whose classification changes shift passive fund flows into and out of a country's equities.

nd21df3cf8e.headline: Trump claims Iran’s president wants a ceasefire, as air strikes batter Tehran
nd21df3cf8e.summary: Trump claimed Iran's president wants a ceasefire as air strikes battered Tehran. Thousands of additional US troops are heading to the Middle East.
nd21df3cf8e.why: Military escalation in Iran affects Gulf oil supply and global energy markets, which matter for inflation and rate expectations.

nf5157c136e.headline: Tourist tax doubles for UK visitors to Spain hotspot from today
nf5157c136e.summary: UK tourists visiting Barcelona will pay up to €15 per night in combined tourist taxes from April 2026, as the municipal surcharge doubles.
nf5157c136e.why: Tourist taxes raise travel costs and can shift visitor numbers and spending, which matters for hotel operators and the tourism economy of major Spanish cities.

n7e09a984e2.headline: Albanese warns fuel crisis from Iran war to hit Australia for months | The Jerusalem Post
n7e09a984e2.summary: Australia imports about 90% of its fuel, and petrol prices have surged with localised shortages due to the US-Israeli war on Iran and the Strait of Hormuz blockade. The prime minister warned the impact could last months.
n7e09a984e2.why: Australia relies heavily on imported refined fuel, so disruptions in Gulf shipping quickly feed into domestic petrol prices, inflation and household costs.

na9d9d4b027.headline: Star Entertainment secures A$590 million refinancing facility
na9d9d4b027.summary: The Star Entertainment Group obtained a binding commitment for an A$590 million refinancing facility from WhiteHawk Capital.
na9d9d4b027.why: Star Entertainment is an Australian casino operator, and refinancing determines its debt obligations and liquidity.

n56e1d0d374.headline: UK will not be dragged into war but fuel prices surge and energy bills set to rise
n56e1d0d374.summary: UK fuel prices are jumping and energy bills risk rising again. Fuel support may not come until autumn, according to the report.
n56e1d0d374.why: Energy prices feed into UK inflation and household budgets. Government support measures affect consumer spending and Bank of England policy.

n2ffff9bf76.headline: India Has Sufficient Crude Supplies For 2 Months; No Fuel Shortage: Govt
n2ffff9bf76.summary: India has secured enough crude for two months, the Petroleum Ministry said, despite Brent crossing $100 a barrel. Retail petrol, diesel and LPG prices remain unchanged after excise cuts.
n2ffff9bf76.why: India is one of the world's largest crude importers, so its supply position and fuel pricing affect global oil demand.

impacts.name: Brent crude
impacts.why: Brent above $100 reflects the supply pressure India is responding to.

n6e7272869d.headline: Lawmakers Slam Govt for Delaying Launch of Starlink, Amazon, OneWeb in Pakistan
n6e7272869d.summary: Pakistan's Senate has raised concerns over delays in issuing satellite internet licences to Starlink, Amazon and other companies. The firms have not yet been able to start operations.
n6e7272869d.why: Satellite broadband licensing determines whether global operators such as Starlink and Amazon's Kuiper can compete in Pakistan's internet market.

n75f0dda3ab.headline: Propane shortage may impact Tata Steel Tinplate operations: MD TV Narendran
n75f0dda3ab.summary: Tata Steel Tinplate's managing director said a propane shortage may impact the company's operations. The comment was reported by The Avenue Mail.
n75f0dda3ab.why: Tata Steel is one of India's largest steelmakers, and fuel input shortages can affect production output and costs.

impacts.name: Tata Steel
impacts.why: A propane shortage could disrupt tinplate production and raise input costs.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h

n25cb510168.headline: Happy 50th birthday, Apple: From near-death to now a USD 3.6 trillion giant
n25cb510168.summary: Apple, founded in a California garage in 1976, is now worth more than $3.6 trillion fifty years after its founding, according to the report.
n25cb510168.why: Apple is one of the world's largest companies by market value, and its iPhone and services businesses drive a major share of global technology spending.

n2471248033.headline: Stagflation risk: Chalmers heeds budget warning
n2471248033.summary: Treasurer Jim Chalmers is being urged to reform tax and migration settings in the upcoming budget. The call comes amid warnings of stagflation risk.
n2471248033.why: The federal budget shapes government spending, taxation and economic growth in Australia. Stagflation combines slow growth with high inflation, a difficult mix for policymakers and markets.

ne7aecf79a7.headline: Electric vehicles make headway amid Iran war
ne7aecf79a7.summary: VinFast's rapid rise in the Philippine electric vehicle market reflects a shift toward EVs as fuel prices soar. The company is using aggressive pricing and infrastructure investment to compete with brands such as BYD.
ne7aecf79a7.why: VinFast is Vietnam's listed electric carmaker expanding into Southeast Asia. Competition with BYD shapes pricing and market share in the region's fast-growing EV segment.

n674c97bd1b.headline: India Data Centre Capacity Set To Rise 30 Per Cent In 2026 With Strong Demand: CBRE Report
n674c97bd1b.summary: CBRE projects India's data centre capacity to grow 30% in 2026 with nearly 500 MW of new supply, with commitments expected to cross $180 billion.
n674c97bd1b.why: Data centres host cloud and AI computing infrastructure, so capacity expansion reflects investment demand from technology and telecom firms.

n28f430c66c.headline: Trump’s Comments Have Triggered a Market Reversal
n28f430c66c.summary: EURUSD bulls launched a counterattack after Donald Trump said the Middle East conflict would be resolved within 2 to 3 weeks. He also called on Gulf states to take back their oil and open the Strait of Hormuz.
n28f430c66c.why: EURUSD is the euro-dollar exchange rate, the most traded currency pair globally. Its moves reflect shifts in relative US and eurozone risk and rate expectations.
n28f430c66c.why_moved: Trump's statement that the Middle East conflict would be resolved within 2 to 3 weeks reversed the currency move. Traders reacted to his call for Gulf states to reopen the Strait of Hormuz.

n6420517183.headline: Commercial LPG cylinder price hiked: Know rates in Hyderabad, other cities
n6420517183.summary: Commercial LPG cylinder prices were raised in Hyderabad and other cities as the spike in global energy prices weighed on India.
n6420517183.why: LPG is a widely used cooking and industrial fuel in India, and its price is linked to global energy markets. Changes affect restaurant and business costs.

nf769cff52a.headline: Bvishal Oil And Energy Files IPO Papers With SEBI, Plans Fresh Issue And OFS To Fund Expansion
nf769cff52a.summary: Gujarat-based Bvishal Oil and Energy filed draft IPO papers with Sebi for a fresh issue of 1.8 crore shares and an offer for sale of 77.09 lakh shares. Proceeds will fund expansion of its oilfield services business.
nf769cff52a.why: A draft IPO filing with India's markets regulator is the first step toward a public listing. Investors track these to gauge new equity supply and sector growth.

n908dad1aee.headline: Investors Are Losing Confidence in Super Micro Computer (SMCI) Stock: ‘It’s Uninvestable’
n908dad1aee.summary: Investors are losing confidence in Super Micro Computer despite strong sales growth. Co-founder Wally Liaw was indicted for allegedly bypassing US export restrictions to China, and he has stepped down.
n908dad1aee.why: Super Micro builds servers used in AI data centers and works closely with Nvidia, so legal and export-control issues affect its customers and supply chain.

nc28a7a7fbc.headline: Four ways a hasty Trump exit from the Iran war may not end the conflict
nc28a7a7fbc.summary: US President Donald Trump is signaling he may walk away from the Iran war without toppling the Islamic Republic, reopening the Strait of Hormuz or securing a deal with Tehran. Analysts say the conflict may continue.
nc28a7a7fbc.why: The Iran conflict affects oil supply through the Strait of Hormuz, so US military and diplomatic decisions influence energy markets worldwide.

nec08b20410.headline: Trump News as Gulf tanker attacks intensify and oil markets brace for disruption
nec08b20410.summary: Authorities in Dubai confirmed a drone attack on a fully loaded Kuwaiti crude oil tanker anchored at Dubai Port. The resulting fire was contained, with no injuries and no oil leakage reported.
nec08b20410.why: Dubai is a major Gulf shipping and trade hub, and attacks on tankers raise insurance costs and disrupt crude shipments.

n070613bb75.headline: Trump claims Iran president wants ceasefire; no response from Iran
n070613bb75.summary: Trump said he could walk away from the war in two to three weeks once confident Iran could not build a nuclear weapon. He said this even if Tehran does not agree to a ceasefire.
n070613bb75.why: Ceasefire talks between the US and Iran affect oil supply risk and broader Gulf stability, which feed into energy and risk-asset prices.

naaded0de9e.headline: Oil gains after Trump says Hormuz to open ‘naturally’ after war
naaded0de9e.summary: Brent crude rose to US$105 a barrel after the US president's national address on the Iran war. Trump said the Strait of Hormuz would open naturally after the war.
naaded0de9e.why: Brent is the main international benchmark for crude oil, so moves in it feed through to fuel costs, inflation expectations and energy equities.
naaded0de9e.why_moved: Brent rose to US$105 a barrel after Trump's national address on the Iran war and his comments that Hormuz would open naturally.

n5baae1ef13.headline: Manila asks Iran to ensure safe passage for Philippine-flagged ships, oil shipments
n5baae1ef13.summary: The Philippines' foreign secretary is set to meet her Iranian counterpart and said she is highly optimistic about a favourable outcome. Manila is seeking safe passage for Philippine-flagged ships and oil shipments.
n5baae1ef13.why: The Philippines imports most of its crude oil, so disruption to tanker traffic through Gulf waters directly affects its fuel supply and costs.

n38f565c315.headline: Lopez family factions confirm Piki ouster, First Gen says business as usual
n38f565c315.summary: Three Lopez family factions say Federico 'Piki' Lopez was removed as president and CEO of the holding company after First Gen Corporation entered several transactions without informing the board. First Gen says business is as usual.
n38f565c315.why: First Gen is a Philippine energy and infrastructure conglomerate, so governance disputes at its family holding company can affect investor confidence and corporate decisions.

n52666e3640.headline: The Latest: Trump addresses the nation on the US war effort in Iran
n52666e3640.summary: Trump gave a prime-time address on the US war effort in Iran, outlining goals to destroy Iran's missile production and Navy and to prevent a nuclear weapon.
n52666e3640.why: US-Iran hostilities affect Middle East security, oil supply routes and global risk sentiment. Investors track these developments for energy and defence exposure.

n09ee0755fe.headline: US-Iran War Day 33 Updates: IRGC reportedly assumes govt control; Tehran’s continued attacks on the Gulf as the world watches West Asia
n09ee0755fe.summary: Attacks spread across Tehran, the Gulf and Lebanon, affecting civilian infrastructure and maritime routes. Trump signalled a potential end to American operations in Iran soon, and markets reacted positively.
n09ee0755fe.why: The Gulf hosts major oil and gas export routes, so disruption to maritime traffic and infrastructure quickly affects global energy markets.
n09ee0755fe.why_moved: Global markets rose on de-escalation hopes after Trump signalled a possible end to US operations, despite continued attacks on the Gulf.

n2a82a95344.headline: Anand to join U.K.-led talks on reopening Strait of Hormuz without U.S. - National | Globalnews.ca
n2a82a95344.summary: Canadian Foreign Minister Anand said Canada will join UK-led talks on reopening the Strait of Hormuz and will help secure it once there is a ceasefire. Specific measures are undecided.
n2a82a95344.why: Canada is a G7 economy and a major energy exporter, so its role in shipping security talks matters for global trade routes.

na471bbebd4.headline: Indonesia Inflation Eases in March as Base Effect Fades
na471bbebd4.summary: Indonesia's consumer inflation slowed to 3.48% in March from 4.76% in February, as a low base effect gradually faded. The report was compiled by MarketScreener.
na471bbebd4.why: Inflation trends guide Bank Indonesia's interest-rate decisions, which affect the rupiah and local bond yields.

na7f8488883.headline: Elon Musk’s SpaceX files for IPO, could raise $75 billion in biggest listing yet - BusinessToday
na7f8488883.summary: Elon Musk's SpaceX has filed for an IPO and is reportedly seeking to raise as much as $75 billion. That would surpass the $29 billion Saudi Aramco listing in 2019, the largest on record.
na7f8488883.why: SpaceX is a private rocket and satellite company, and a listing of this size would be the largest IPO on record. It would test investor appetite for mega-cap offerings.

n618af8efb4.headline: Trade minister urges utmost efforts to secure oil, naphtha supplies amid Mideast crisis
n618af8efb4.summary: Trade Minister Yeo Han-koo called for utmost efforts to secure alternative oil and naphtha supplies to reduce uncertainty for Korean companies amid the Middle East crisis.
n618af8efb4.why: South Korea imports nearly all its crude oil and relies on naphtha as a petrochemical feedstock. Supply disruptions hit its refiners and chemical exporters.

n8faf134f5c.headline: 'Priming domestic demand' vs. 'short-term fix': Cash aid plan draws mixed reactions
n8faf134f5c.summary: Small business owners are sharply divided over the government's plan to offer up to 600,000 won in cash assistance to households. Supporters see it as priming domestic demand, while critics call it a short-term fix.
n8faf134f5c.why: Cash handouts are a fiscal tool that can boost household spending and domestic demand. Such measures are closely watched for their effect on inflation and public debt.

n2789ea5b5d.headline: Korea's monthly exports top $80 bil. mark for 1st time in March
n2789ea5b5d.summary: Korea's monthly exports breached the $80 billion mark for the first time in March, jumping nearly 50 percent from a year earlier. The rise was driven by strong shipments.
n2789ea5b5d.why: Exports are a major share of South Korea's economy, and export data is a closely watched gauge of global trade and chip demand.

n3f88442554.headline: Pakistan Faces LNG Supply Disruption for Power Generation Amid Gulf Tensions
n3f88442554.summary: Pakistan's liquefied natural gas supplies for power generation are currently unavailable under force majeure conditions, officials said. The disruption is linked to Gulf tensions.
n3f88442554.why: LNG imports are a key fuel for Pakistan's power sector, so supply cuts affect electricity generation and energy costs.

n3adaab3d69.headline: Petrol and Diesel Prices Likely to Increase Within Days
n3adaab3d69.summary: The government of Pakistan is preparing to increase petrol and diesel prices within days. It aims to partially pass higher import costs on to consumers.
n3adaab3d69.why: Fuel prices feed into inflation and transport costs, and they are closely tracked by investors in emerging markets.

ne786a182de.headline: Indonesia Tightens Free-Float Rules in Bid to Boost Investor Confidence
ne786a182de.summary: Indonesia will give listed companies up to three years to meet a higher minimum free-float requirement. The Indonesia Stock Exchange rule aims to boost investor confidence.
ne786a182de.why: Free-float rules determine how many shares are available to public investors, affecting liquidity and index eligibility on the Jakarta exchange.

nab2f2f9642.headline: Stock Market Today: Sensex, Nifty50 Surge as US-Iran Tensions Ease
nab2f2f9642.summary: Indian equities rallied sharply on Dalal Street as easing tensions in the US-Iran conflict and stable oil prices lifted sentiment. The Nifty 50 and BSE Sensex both gained.
nab2f2f9642.why: The BSE Sensex and NSE Nifty 50 are India's benchmark equity indices, tracking the country's largest listed companies. Oil prices and Middle East tensions matter to India as a major energy importer.

impacts.name: BSE Sensex
impacts.why: Broad Indian equity rally reported in the article, tied to easing US-Iran tensions.

impacts.name: Nifty 50
impacts.why: The Nifty 50 rallied alongside the Sensex according to the report.

nab2f2f9642.why_moved: The article attributes the rally to easing tensions in the US-Iran conflict and stable oil prices boosting sentiment.

nf208c62cb7.headline: Indonesia diversifies energy sources to reduce Middle East dependence
nf208c62cb7.summary: Indonesia is diversifying its energy sources to secure fuel supply amid Middle East tensions. Imports from the region account for about 20 percent of supply, according to Energy officials.
nf208c62cb7.why: Indonesia is a major Southeast Asian energy consumer and importer. Fuel supply security and import costs directly affect its budget and inflation.

nf3c61f2f07.headline: February's trade surplus supports external economic growth: BI
nf3c61f2f07.summary: Bank Indonesia said Indonesia's February 2026 trade surplus of US$1.27 billion is crucial to bolstering the external resilience of the economy.
nf3c61f2f07.why: Bank Indonesia is the country's central bank. Trade balances feed into the current account and the rupiah, which matter for investors in Indonesian assets.

n199e073dc6.headline: Indonesia, South Korea launch cross-border QR-based payment system
n199e073dc6.summary: Bank Indonesia and the Bank of Korea launched a cross-border QR code-based payment system between the two countries on Wednesday.
n199e073dc6.why: Bank Indonesia and the Bank of Korea are the two central banks overseeing their national payment systems. Cross-border payment links can reduce transaction costs and build fintech demand.

n5881de0d2a.headline: Petrol Prices to cross Rs350 Per Litre in Pakistan in April amid Global Oil Surge?
n5881de0d2a.summary: Pakistanis face another blow as petrol prices are expected to rise again, possibly above Rs350 per litre, amid a global oil surge.
n5881de0d2a.why: Fuel prices feed directly into Pakistan's inflation and monetary policy, and they are set through government pricing decisions tied to international oil prices.

n2dba8d5fec.headline: Govt mulls Rs31b spending on wheat stocks
n2dba8d5fec.summary: The Pakistani government is considering spending Rs31 billion on wheat stocks, according to the report.
n2dba8d5fec.why: Wheat procurement and stockpiling affect food inflation and fiscal spending in Pakistan, where wheat is a staple food.

n4806927f67.headline: CPEC-II to prioritise industry, innovation
n4806927f67.summary: The second phase of the China-Pakistan Economic Corridor, CPEC-II, will prioritise industry and innovation, according to the report.
n4806927f67.why: The China-Pakistan Economic Corridor is a China-backed infrastructure and investment program, and its priorities shape foreign investment flows into Pakistan.
